title: Route the security threat / risk decision to badf-security-design, and generalize the family-name guard against a governed declared_future_families list
objective: badf-solution-design's routing table sent the security threat / risk decision to `badf-security`, a family that has never been in the registry, while badf-security-design is ACTIVE and owns exactly that concern -- so a reader following the table defers a decision that is routable today. Fix the row, and generalize #222's badf-build-only family-name guard across every skills/<family>/** surface so the class cannot recur silently. The guard permits an unresolved token ONLY when it appears in a new governed `declared_future_families` list in badf/skill-registry.json -- the authoritative surface for family names -- rather than when nearby prose labels it. #223's original label-adjacency criterion was measured backwards on the real corpus and dropped.
business_value: Closes a live wrong name in shipped routing content and replaces an inferred exception (prose adjacency) with a declared one, so a genuine typo can no longer pass by being written apologetically.
in_scope: skills/badf-solution-design/references/routing.md: the security threat / risk decision row only
badf/skill-registry.json: new top-level declared_future_families list, badf-security-assurance its single member
tests/test_badf_family_names.py: the generalized guard, anti-vacuity assertions, and the content pin on the routed row
docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; reconcile WP-2026-0123; own G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: building badf-security-assurance; any registry STATUS change to any family

the generalized declared-future MECHANISM for absent enforcement inputs -- deferred into #246's single answer for the class (C3 expected_surfaces, C7 delegation ceiling, GIT-F composition record, undeclared future family)
any other routing row, and any other family's surface content
acceptance_criteria: the security threat / risk decision row routes to badf-security-design and carries no stale 'future'; no other row changed
the guard scans every skills/<family>/** surface and refuses an unresolved badf-* token unless it is in declared_future_families
all 17 badf-security-assurance uses across 12 files stay green -- because the name is DECLARED, not because a test lists it
the declared-future surface cannot be satisfied by a bare name: an entry without name/declared_by/gate/reason is refused, and an entry no surface references is refused as dead permission
anti-vacuity: moving skills/ aside fails the guard loudly rather than passing on nothing
repo integrity clean; compose green; the registry addition is schema-additive with no per-family digest movement
a name cannot be both registered and declared-future: building a family DISCHARGES its forward-reference entry, so the list stays finite rather than decaying into a permanent allowlist

the matcher folds Unicode dashes so a pasted U+2011 reference is checked as written, and its remaining scope limits (uppercase, underscore) are DECLARED in source with the measurement that justifies them rather than left as the next reviewer's finding

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; the routing row and the declared-future list revert together
